claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The theorem is deliberately narrowed to the full finite-window optimum/count and exact threshold multiplicities. The three covered background facts are acknowledged; the new numbers do not follow by arithmetic from the total and extrema.

originality.rationale: The 2016/2017 universal-hitting-set work defines the finite-window problem but supplies no exact binary four-mer optimization multiplicities. Champarnaud et al. 2004 establishes only the eventual six-necklace lower bound. Zheng et al. 2021 already determines the total thirty minimum decycling sets and Marçais et al. 2024 already establishes the remaining-path range 5 to 7, so neither is claimed new. The full finite-window 4..10 optimum/cardinality multiplicity census and refined exact distribution 10,4,16 are not stated or implied by those known endpoint and total facts. Supplementary/unindexed small-case comparisons remain a risk.
residual_risks: An inaccessible supplemental document associated with the 2021 work could contain the small-case histogram; it was not represented as inspected.
Unindexed published tables, associated software repositories, or unpublished work cannot be excluded by available literature searches.
The 2016 conference date is the first verified archival day stamp used here, not proof of the earliest worldwide public posting.
